To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the coupling between modules is the main cause of software complexity and reengineering of software modules is a good way to decrease the coupling between modules and hence decrease the complexity of software.

(1) The coupling factor (CF) is an effective metric to measure the complexity of a module in a software system; (2) the CF can be used to identify the most complex modules in a software system and to measure the effectiveness of reengineering; (3) the CF can also be used to evaluate the impact of software maintenance activities; (4) the CF can help in the identification of software components that need to be refactored.
The coupling factor of the modules of existing system is higher than reengineered system.
